import unittest
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

from vaultsnap import Policy, Snapshot, plan_retention

NOW = datetime.fromisoformat("2026-03-20T12:00:00+00:00")


def S(id, stamp, *tags):
    return Snapshot(id, datetime.fromisoformat(stamp), frozenset(tags))


class AdrTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_iso_week_year_boundary(self):
        # 2025-12-30 is ISO week (2026,1); 2025-12-28 (Sunday) is (2025,52): different weeks.
        shots = [S("a", "2025-12-28T03:00+00:00"), S("b", "2025-12-30T03:00+00:00")]
        plan = plan_retention(shots, Policy(keep_weekly=2), NOW)
        self.assertEqual(plan.prune, [])
        # Monthly/yearly use calendar values, not ISO year.
        plan = plan_retention(shots, Policy(keep_yearly=1), NOW)
        self.assertEqual(plan.keep, ["b"])

    def test_sunday_and_monday_are_different_weeks(self):
        shots = [S("sun", "2026-03-08T03:00+00:00"), S("mon", "2026-03-09T03:00+00:00")]
        self.assertEqual(plan_retention(shots, Policy(keep_weekly=2), NOW).prune, [])

    def test_day_start_hour_shifts_all_keys(self):
        shots = [S("a", "2026-01-01T03:30+00:00"), S("b", "2025-12-31T10:00+00:00")]
        plan = plan_retention(shots, Policy(keep_yearly=1, day_start_hour=4), NOW)
        self.assertEqual(plan.keep, ["a"])  # both are 2025-12-31 -> a is newest
        plan = plan_retention(shots, Policy(keep_yearly=1), NOW)
        self.assertEqual(plan.keep, ["a"])
        self.assertEqual(plan.prune, ["b"])
        plan = plan_retention(shots, Policy(keep_yearly=2, day_start_hour=4), NOW)
        self.assertEqual(plan.prune, ["b"])

    def test_tz_offset(self):
        shots = [S("a", "2026-03-10T23:30+00:00"), S("b", "2026-03-10T10:00+00:00")]
        self.assertEqual(plan_retention(shots, Policy(keep_daily=5), NOW).keep, ["a", "b"][:1] + ["b"][:0] or ["a"])
        plan = plan_retention(shots, Policy(keep_daily=5, tz_offset_minutes=60), NOW)
        self.assertEqual(plan.keep, ["a", "b"])

    def test_future_and_protected_do_not_count(self):
        shots = [
            S("future", "2026-03-21T00:00+00:00"),
            S("prot", "2026-03-19T00:00+00:00", "rel"),
            S("x", "2026-03-18T00:00+00:00"),
            S("y", "2026-03-17T00:00+00:00"),
        ]
        plan = plan_retention(shots, Policy(keep_last=1, keep_daily=1, protect_tags={"rel"}), NOW)
        self.assertEqual(plan.keep, ["future", "prot", "x"])
        self.assertEqual(plan.prune, ["y"])

    def test_snapshot_at_now_is_not_set_aside(self):
        shots = [S("a", "2026-03-20T12:00+00:00"), S("b", "2026-03-19T12:00+00:00")]
        plan = plan_retention(shots, Policy(keep_last=1), NOW)
        self.assertEqual((plan.keep, plan.prune), (["a"], ["b"]))

    def test_tie_break_by_id_and_rules_independent(self):
        shots = [S("a", "2026-03-10T03:00+00:00"), S("b", "2026-03-10T03:00+00:00")]
        plan = plan_retention(shots, Policy(keep_daily=1), NOW)
        self.assertEqual((plan.keep, plan.prune), (["b"], ["a"]))

    def test_empty_buckets_do_not_count(self):
        shots = [S("a", "2026-03-01T03:00+00:00"), S("b", "2026-03-15T03:00+00:00")]
        self.assertEqual(plan_retention(shots, Policy(keep_daily=2), NOW).prune, [])

    def test_errors(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            plan_retention([], Policy(keep_last=1), datetime(2026, 1, 1))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            plan_retention([S("a", "2026-03-01T00:00+00:00")] * 2, Policy(keep_last=1), NOW)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):  # even with an empty policy
            plan_retention([Snapshot("n", datetime(2026, 1, 1))], Policy(), NOW)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
